name: Commercial name
hintName: Displayed in the catalog, product sheets, and quotes.
hintSlug: Public URL of the record. Click “Auto” to generate it from the name.
hintCategory: Choose an existing category or create a new one.
hintSku: Unique internal reference. Automatically assigned by the server if left empty.
hintPrice: Amount + currency (managed in E-shop → Currencies) or “On quote”.
hintVatRate: Leave empty to use the store default VAT (e.g. 19%).
hintVatIncluded: When enabled, the entered price already includes VAT.
hintDiscountType: Direct discount applied to this product.
hintDiscountValue: Percentage (0–100) or fixed amount depending on the chosen type.
hintShippingType: How product-specific shipping fees are calculated.
hintZones: Comma-separated zone codes (e.g. DZ-16, DZ-31). Empty = all active zones.
hintStockFinal: Automatically decremented on each validated order.
hintFullDesc: Full description with formatting, tables, lists, and visuals.
placeholderZones: e.g. DZ-16, DZ-31 or empty = all
